development.demonstrations: disjoint from all original C80 calibration and original40 heldout, and between outer and confirmation

training.loss: first10 x6 motor MSE + rho * frozen c * clean future global NMSE excluding frame0

bilevel.objective: four-suite equal mean first10 motor RMSE on alternating outer development batches
bilevel.selection: final round8 rho, then retrain fixed rho from common untrained C8 banks; no confirmation/test reselection

preflight.restore: exact master parameters, Adam state, RNG, cursor and reset flag; deployed action/future parity
preflight.repeat_branch: repeat plus branch at nonempty-Adam update8 with identical state and RNG
preflight.signal_gate: at least one state passes relative deadband and plus/minus contrast exceeds three times replay discrepancy; both states restore exactly

evaluation.fixed_comparator: lowest complete outer-development first10 motor RMSE among low/current; ties prefer lower rho
evaluation.advance_gate: selected first10 motor RMSE at least1% lower on BOTH confirmation and historical; each other metric no more than5% worse on both
evaluation.aggregation: mean seeds within case, mean cases within suite, four suites equally
evaluation.evidence: single frozen C8 training trajectory, two inference seeds; pilot engineering gate, historical test already observed, decoded BF16/fake A4; no closed-loop or native kernel claim

authorization: execute this frozen plan; preflight must pass before any full C8 pilot job submission; no C80 or clipping expansion
